indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Fell about 335 points in its worst session since early 2025.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Dropped into correction territory as chip and AI stocks sold off hard.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Lost about 1,833 points, giving back Wednesday's post-election rally.

notes: AI and semiconductor stocks led a broad sell-off: the chip index fell about 12%, with AMD and Micron down roughly 17% and Nvidia down about 9%.
Investors worried that the Democratic win in Congress could bring tighter rules on data-center buildout, and some took profits in this year's AI leaders; Tesla and SpaceX also fell more than 9%.
The VIX volatility gauge jumped about 70% to around 28, the 10-year Treasury yield slipped to about 4.84%, and WTI crude rebounded about 3% to near $91.
